2022 | Score: 10

Some of the best prose I have read all summer. I now understand why fans are upset at Patrick Rothfuss for not finishing the series for 10 years. This is an incredible book and has a perfect mix of character to action to dialogue to drama. Love it awesome you go book. Kvothe is a 11/10 main character (or mary sue depending on how you look at it)

2024 | Score: 10

I think I enjoyed it even more the second time. Knowing when the bad stuff would happen I could feel my whole body tense up in anticipation because the books just sucks you in. I love the narrative style and obviously the prose is outstanding. I really hope the last book comes out before I die.
